title: A Failed Rocket Launch Hits Amazon's Internet Satellite Plans
title_zh: 火箭发射失败，亚马逊互联网卫星计划受挫
source_name: Reuters — “Rocket from Boeing-Lockheed firm fails mid-flight, destroys payload of Amazon satellites” (15 Nov 2026)
summary_zh: 据路透社11月15日报道，由波音与洛克希德·马丁合资的联合发射联盟（ULA）“火神”（Vulcan）火箭当天从美国佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角升空，计划把40颗亚马逊Leo互联网卫星送入轨道，但飞行约10分钟后出现异常，任务失败，卫星未能入轨。ULA表示，目前还没有足够数据说明故障原因，将展开调查并尽快恢复飞行。路透社称，这是ULA成立20年来的首次任务失败。亚马逊Leo旨在与SpaceX的星链竞争；自2025年以来已有398颗卫星在轨，仅约占实现全球覆盖所需3236颗的12%。这次失败可能导致后续发射推迟。
paragraphs: On 15 November 2026, a Vulcan rocket lifted off from Cape Canaveral Space Force Station in Florida, carrying a payload of 40 internet satellites for Amazon's Leo network. About ten minutes later, the mission failed. The satellites never reached orbit and were lost. The rocket is operated by United Launch Alliance (ULA), a joint venture of Boeing and Lockheed Martin.

In an official statement, ULA said the vehicle "suffered an anomaly 10 minutes into the flight and failed to deliver the Amazon mission to orbit." The company added that it did not yet have enough data to explain what went wrong. According to Reuters, this was ULA's first mission failure in its 20-year history. The firm said it would work with Amazon and other organisations to find the cause and return to flight as quickly as possible.

The launch was an important test for Vulcan, ULA's new flagship rocket. It was only the fifth Vulcan flight since the rocket's debut in 2024, and the first in nearly nine months. Earlier flights had problems with the rocket's solid side boosters, although those missions still delivered their payloads. On Sunday, the side boosters appeared to work as planned, but a different problem stopped the mission. The exact cause remains under investigation.

The lost satellites were meant to expand Amazon Leo, a planned network of thousands of spacecraft that would offer broadband internet from low Earth orbit and compete with SpaceX's Starlink service. Reuters reports that since 2025, Amazon has placed 398 Leo satellites into orbit across 14 launches — only about 12 percent of the 3,236 satellites it says it needs for global coverage. The company had hoped to start an initial service this year. Amazon has booked dozens of future Vulcan launches, so a long investigation could delay the whole programme.

Amazon said there is risk with any launch, especially an inaugural mission such as this one, known as LV-01. It called ULA a trusted partner and said it believed the company would learn from the failure. The setback also highlights a wider challenge: unlike SpaceX, which launches its own Starlink satellites on its own rockets, Amazon depends on other companies to reach space. When a partner's rocket fails, the internet network has to wait as well.
paragraphs_zh: 2026年11月15日，一枚“火神”（Vulcan）火箭从美国佛罗里达州卡纳维拉尔角太空部队基地升空，载荷是亚马逊Leo网络的40颗互联网卫星。大约10分钟后，任务失败。这些卫星未能进入轨道，已经损失。这枚火箭由联合发射联盟（ULA）运营，该公司是波音与洛克希德·马丁的合资企业。
联合发射联盟在官方声明中表示，这枚火箭“在飞行进行到10分钟时出现异常，未能将亚马逊的任务送入轨道”。该公司还说，目前还没有足够的数据来解释故障原因。据路透社报道，这是联合发射联盟成立20年来的首次任务失败。该公司表示，将与亚马逊及其他机构合作查明原因，并尽快恢复飞行。
此次发射是对“火神”火箭的一次重要检验，它是联合发射联盟的新一代主力火箭。这只是该型火箭自2024年首飞以来的第五次飞行，也是近九个月来的首次发射。此前的飞行曾出现固体助推器问题，不过那些任务仍把载荷送入了轨道。周日，固体助推器看起来运行正常，但另一个问题使任务中止。确切原因仍在调查中。

损失的卫星本应用于扩充亚马逊Leo——这是一个规划中的、由数千颗航天器组成的网络，计划从近地轨道提供宽带互联网，并与太空探索技术公司（SpaceX）的星链（Starlink）服务竞争。路透社报道，自2025年以来，亚马逊已通过14次发射将398颗Leo卫星送入轨道，仅相当于其声称实现全球覆盖所需3236颗卫星的约12%。该公司曾希望在今年启动初期服务。亚马逊还预订了数十次后续的“火神”火箭发射，因此一旦调查耗时过长，整个计划都可能被推迟。
亚马逊表示，任何发射都有风险，对于像这次名为LV-01的首次任务来说尤其如此。它称联合发射联盟是值得信赖的合作伙伴，并表示相信该公司会从这次失败中吸取教训。这次挫折也凸显出一个更广泛的难题：与用自己的火箭发射自家星链卫星的SpaceX不同，亚马逊要依靠其他公司才能进入太空。一旦合作方的火箭失败，这个互联网网络也只得等待。

key_words.meaning_zh: n. （火箭等的）有效载荷；负载

phrases.meaning_zh: 未能送达；未能完成交付

questions.prompt: What is the passage mainly about?
options: A plan by Amazon to buy SpaceX and take over the Starlink network.
A failed Vulcan rocket launch that destroyed 40 Amazon internet satellites and may delay the Leo network.
An official decision by the US government to ban all commercial rocket launches.
A successful test in which ULA's side boosters failed but the satellites still reached orbit.
questions.explanation: 全文主旨是11月15日联合发射联盟的“火神”火箭发射失败，40颗亚马逊Leo互联网卫星未能进入轨道，调查可能推迟后续发射计划。文中并未说亚马逊要收购SpaceX、美国政府禁止商业发射，也不是“助推器出问题但卫星仍成功入轨”的任务。

evidence.quote: About ten minutes later, the mission failed. The satellites never reached orbit and were lost.

questions.prompt: According to Reuters, how many Amazon Leo satellites have been placed into orbit since 2025?
options: 40 satellites, which is already enough for global coverage.
3,236 satellites, already more than Starlink has in space.
398 satellites across 14 launches, about 12 percent of the number needed for global coverage.
14 satellites, with one satellite from each successful launch.
questions.explanation: 第四段明确引用路透社的数据：自2025年以来，亚马逊已通过14次发射将398颗Leo卫星送入轨道，仅约占其声称实现全球覆盖所需3236颗卫星的12%。40颗是这次失败任务上的卫星数量，3236是目标总数，并非已经在轨的数量。

evidence.quote: since 2025, Amazon has placed 398 Leo satellites into orbit across 14 launches — only about 12 percent of the 3,236 satellites it says it needs for global coverage.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about why this failure may affect more than the 40 lost satellites?
options: Amazon has already cancelled the Leo project and will not try to launch again.
The lost satellites contained unique technology that cannot be rebuilt.
Because Amazon has booked many future Vulcan launches and depends on other companies' rockets, a long investigation could delay the wider programme.
SpaceX has agreed to stop launching Starlink until ULA finishes its investigation.
questions.explanation: 第四段指出亚马逊还预订了数十次后续的“火神”火箭发射，调查一旦拖长，整个计划都可能被推迟；第五段又说明亚马逊要依靠其他公司的火箭才能进入太空。由此可以推断，影响不止于当天损失的40颗卫星。文中没有说项目已被取消、卫星技术无法重建，或SpaceX会因此停止发射星链。

evidence.quote: Amazon has booked dozens of future Vulcan launches, so a long investigation could delay the whole programme.
